programs.title: Mark Berg's Fishing Addiction
programs.desc: Fishing expert Mark Berg visits some of the best fishing destinations around. Chasing a wide variety of fish, Mark is always hoping to capture a new species or develop a new technique.

programs.title: Merv Hughes Fishing
programs.desc: Merv Hughes Fishing is a light hearted fishing show with some ripping catches, a few yarns (mostly true), mateship and of course a splash of comedy thrown in.

programs.title: The Fishing Show By AFN
programs.desc: Bill & James visit the Arcadia Native Fish Hatchery to showcase their work with Murray Cod and Golden Perch. They also look at a nearby fishery that is revitalising a community space for all anglers.

programs.title: Garage 41
programs.desc: An exploration of the Burt Munro Challenge; a review of the Jeep Wrangler Gladiator; driving with Brendan Reeves.

programs.title: Counting Cars
programs.desc: Music industry heavyweight Del Bryant turns to the shop to customize his Blazer to pay tribute to his roots in Tennessee, while elsewhere, Mike and Ryan discover an incredibly rare 1963 Oldsmobile Count may want to purchase.

programs.title: Counting Cars
programs.desc: Inspired by the Rat Rods at a local shop, Danny sends the guys out to find parts for a Count's Kustoms Rat Rod. While on the hunt, Danny gets distracted by a beauty of a Bel Air and finds himself on the other side of the bargaining table.
